system.summary: Stager route cipher: words written in columns and copied by a route set by an indicator word, with printed code words (two per meaning, meanings filled in by hand for each issue) for names, places, punctuation and common words, and padding words at the end.
system.notes: The ledgers record the telegrams with the route already undone, so only the code layer is open. Entries counts the Book #1 vocabulary rows of copy mssEC 43 (key_book1_mssEC43.tsv). Each meaning has two code words (left and right printed word): homophones in that sense. Units: the ledger text is words (code words among clear words); length unit "mixed".

prior_solution.where: Decoded at the time; many of the telegrams are printed in clear in the Official Records. No modern decoding of the ledgers' code layer published (Decoding the Civil War phase 3 not reported; searched 27 Oct 2026).

solution.what: Searched for a Decoding the Civil War decipherment phase, a code-word glossary or a data export: none published.

mssEC 37, 38, 40 checked for the 1862 filling: post-1866 codes and Banks's 1863 Gulf issue.
